name: Flying Birds
overview: Scripture reveals that flying birds are part of God's intentional creation, brought forth by His command to fill the skies (Genesis 1:20). These creatures depend entirely on God's provision, as seen in Job 38:41 where God cares for the raven and its young. Jesus further emphasizes God's faithful care by reminding us that the birds do not sow or reap, yet the heavenly Father feeds them, assuring believers of His greater provision for humanity (Matthew 6:26).
